text:
Marta Ivanov: created PR for rate-limits + quotas + usage analytics updates: https://github.com/redwood-inference/docs/pull/498. Changes: tier wording, meter naming, FAQ entry on metering units, and example SDK snippets (Go + Python). Need quick eyes on Go snippet and a screenshot path fix.

Ethan Zhou: looking now. FYI I spotted the image path typo in the doc referencing `/assets/usage/console-overview.png` but repo has `/assets/console/usage-overview.png`. I'll patch.

Nina Romero: quick question on headers in examples 14 are we using `X-RateLimit-Remaining` everywhere? I saw a sample with `X-Quota-Remaining`. prefer to keep `X-RateLimit-*` for public docs.

Marta Ivanov: yes keep `X-RateLimit-*` public. `X-Quota-*` is internal only and shouldn't be in examples. I'll replace the one instance.

Omar Haddad: small content nit on pricing tiers: the enterprise row says "volume discounts applied monthly" 12 legal flagged it. suggestion: "volume discounts are applied per billing cycle; see billing FAQ".

Marta Ivanov: noted. I'll change the sentence and link to the FAQ anchor.

Ethan Zhou: Go snippet is fine but needs import + context example. propose tiny snippet:
```go
resp, err := client.Generate(ctx, req)
if err != nil { log.Fatal(err) }
fmt.Println(resp.Headers.Get("X-RateLimit-Remaining"))
```
Keep it compact.

Nina Romero: also adding Python retry hint and a one-liner about reading `x-ratelimit-reset` as unix seconds.

Marta Ivanov: thanks. other follow-ups: add CSV export sample fields in the billing docs (timestamp, account_id, meter, value), and clarify that Console charts aggregate per-minute buckets which may smooth short bursts.

Omar Haddad: on dedicated migration note: confirm quotas are enforced per-reservation and billed to the reservation owner. I added a bullet but product should confirm.

Marta Ivanov: pinging @product in the PR description.

docs-bot: PR #498 status: checks passed 14 CI, lint; reviewers requested: Ethan Zhou, Nina Romero.

Marta Ivanov: I'll merge after Ethan approves and I fix the image path. Thanks all! :sparkles:
